check.question: For every team existing at the end of March 31, 2026, return its ID and number of open or pending tickets it owned then, including zero.
check.sql: WITH cutoff(c) AS (VALUES ('2026-04-01 00:00:00')), last_status AS (SELECT e.ticket_id, se.to_status AS status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.ticket_id ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC, e.seq DESC) AS rn FROM ticket_status_events se JOIN ticket_events e ON e.event_id = se.event_id WHERE e.occurred_at < (SELECT c FROM cutoff)), last_team AS (SELECT e.ticket_id, ae.to_team_id AS team_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.ticket_id ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC, e.seq DESC) AS rn FROM ticket_assignment_events ae JOIN ticket_events e ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.occurred_at < (SELECT c FROM cutoff)) SELECT et.team_id, COUNT(d.ticket_id) AS open_or_pending FROM (SELECT team_id FROM teams WHERE created_at < (SELECT c FROM cutoff)) et LEFT JOIN (SELECT ls.ticket_id, lt.team_id FROM last_status ls JOIN last_team lt ON lt.ticket_id = ls.ticket_id JOIN ticket_statuses ts ON ts.status_code = ls.status WHERE ls.rn = 1 AND lt.rn = 1 AND ts.counts_as_backlog = 1) d ON d.team_id = et.team_id GROUP BY et.team_id ORDER BY et.team_id;
check.wrong_sql: WITH cutoff(c) AS (VALUES ('2026-04-01 00:00:00')), last_status AS (SELECT e.ticket_id, se.to_status AS status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.ticket_id ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC, e.seq DESC) AS rn FROM ticket_status_events se JOIN ticket_events e ON e.event_id = se.event_id WHERE e.occurred_at <= (SELECT c FROM cutoff)), last_team AS (SELECT e.ticket_id, ae.to_team_id AS team_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.ticket_id ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC, e.seq DESC) AS rn FROM ticket_assignment_events ae JOIN ticket_events e ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.occurred_at <= (SELECT c FROM cutoff)) SELECT et.team_id, COUNT(d.ticket_id) AS open_or_pending FROM (SELECT team_id FROM teams WHERE created_at < (SELECT c FROM cutoff)) et LEFT JOIN (SELECT ls.ticket_id, lt.team_id FROM last_status ls JOIN last_team lt ON lt.ticket_id = ls.ticket_id JOIN ticket_statuses ts ON ts.status_code = ls.status WHERE ls.rn = 1 AND lt.rn = 1 AND ts.counts_as_backlog = 1) d ON d.team_id = et.team_id GROUP BY et.team_id ORDER BY et.team_id;
check.witness: Ticket 4001 (event_id 40002) transfers team 50 -> 60 EXACTLY at 2026-04-01 00:00:00, the exclusive March cutoff. The March snapshot must keep 4001 under team 50 (backlog 1) and must list team 60 with zero. The wrong_sql uses an inclusive cutoff (<=), replays the midnight transfer, and reports team 50 = 0 and team 60 = 1. (Related check: ticket 3001 closes exactly at the cutoff, so it remains pending under team 90 in March; the inclusive version drops it but admits ticket 3002 created exactly at the cutoff, so team 90 coincidentally stays 3 — the 50/60 swap is the clean discriminator.)
